mods.name: Re-Avaritia
mods.description:
Are you the type of modded Minecraft player that makes a beeline for the designated "end game" and then gives up on ever playing again once you get there? Do you wish there was a way to make the process take significantly longer? Do you love GregTech, but wish it weren't so short? Do you sit down on your chest full of Galgadorian Drills and wish there was a mod that didn't just hand things to you on a silver platter?

 

This might be the mod for you!

releases.notes:
# ChangeLog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file，ChangeLog information is generated by the [CommitMessage plugin](https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/12256-commit-message-create)

## [v1.4.2-release-neoforge-26.3](https://github.com/Nova-Committee/Re-Avaritia/releases/tag/v1.4.2-release-neoforge-26.3)

### feat

* 首次发布 Minecraft 26.3 版本，目标 NeoForge 26.3.0.45-beta，运行需要 Java 25。
* #376：新增可选 Equivox API 联动，沿用 1.21.1 ProjectE 的基础 EMC、奇点数量提升及无尽工作台、压缩机、无尽锻造配方映射；保持未安装 Equivox 时安全加载。

### fix

* #381：无尽剑强制击杀保留真实玩家归因和死亡/掉落事件；原生事件未触发时补发一次，避免第三方掉落监听器被跳过或重复执行。
* #378：补齐 `c:nuggets`、`c:ingots`、`c:storage_blocks` 根标签，以及水晶矩阵方块物品的 `c:gems`；同时生成对应方块存储标签。

### verification

* Minecraft 26.3 / NeoForge 26.3.0.45-beta：未装 Equivox 时 41 项 GameTest 通过。
* 26.3 原生客户端未装 Equivox 时创建世界、获取并渲染无尽剑，以及真实右键打开无尽箱界面通过。
* 官方 `Equivox-26.3-1.4.0.jar` 在此 NeoForge 的客户端与服务端构造阶段均因缺少 `net.neoforged.neoforge.items.ItemStackHandler` 失败；存在环境的 EMC 验收需要上游兼容发布包，不能用 API 编译或缺席环境的通过结果替代。Jonn's Trophies 26.1.2 的 3.0.0 发布包也因已移除的 `ModConfig.Type.SERVER` 无法启动，不能作为本分支的实装奖杯兼容证明。

## [v1.4.2-release-neoforge-26.1.2](http://github.com/Nova-Committee/Re-Avaritia/compare/v1.4.1-release-neoforge-26.1.2...v1.4.2-release-neoforge-26.1.2)

### feat

* Port PortableUi, native lists/item grids, context menus, layered dialogs and affected screens to the native GUI extractor/input APIs; remove obsolete OperationButton, keyboard-event and coordinate helpers. Isolated development inspection is available with `-PuiInspect=true`.
* Add Infinity Ring and Neutron Ring to the main creative tab, and a 9×9 extreme-table recipe that upgrades a Neutron Ring into an Infinity Ring.
* Synchronize Infinity Bucket's four-row fluid/creature management, direct carried-container transfers, selection and destructive context actions. Preserve aquatic bucket names, variants, age and health with transactional creature/fluid transfers and water consumption.
* Synchronize Infinity Ring personal dimensions, role/ban management, per-player returns, flight ownership and dimension deletion, including creation and control screens.
* Replace the Neutron Ring backpack UI with a player-bound structure library, fixed 16×16×16 two-click capture/place and detailed block/entity/fluid previews. Retain legacy inventory contents in server-side recovery storage when the player's inventory lacks space.


### fix

* 移除 NeoForge 26 已失效的 `@OnlyIn`；`OperationMenu` 仅由客户端界面引用。
* 无尽箱子锁定按钮改回与 1.21.1 相同的图集图标，不再显示 L/U 文字。

* upgrade Infinity Bucket with management menu, aquatic capture, and native FluidStack persistence
* Infinity Bucket right-click auto-collects fluid sources, outputs selected fluid or releases creatures on non-source blocks, and uses one cancellable BlockSnapshot place path
